name: project_recovery_inspector_v1
description: Evidence-first project root-cause inspector that scans real source files and user-authorized chat exports, classifies blockers, generates deterministic repair possibilities, and preserves verified/unverified/external truth states.
mutation_policy: Read-only inspection by default. Report writing is a separately permissioned write. Repair execution remains outside this skill and must use Selma's existing command/permission/audit control plane.
